disposition_reason: Explicit primary-endpoint-v1 selection of an exact author-reported decoder. Authentic references, source identities, replay and operational/scientific admission remain unresolved; scope construction is not a result.

source_paper.title: Population analyses reveal heterogenous encoding in the medial prefrontal cortex during naturalistic foraging

evidence.locator: Figure 6A,B and Results: Population activities in the E-zone encode success and failure of avoidance; Methods: Head-withdrawal-type classification
evidence.supports: Reports avoidance-versus-escape balanced accuracy of 72.71%, shuffled 51.62%, across 40 sessions, using peri-withdrawal neural activity and stratified fivefold evaluation.

evidence.locator: EventClassifier.fitBNB; X/y loading and clipping; HW label selection; Batch_EventClassifier
evidence.supports: Defines seed 622 stratified fivefold splits, BernoulliNB uniform priors, pooled out-of-fold probabilities, 0.5 threshold and mean session accuracy. Code uses an unseeded generator for shuffled labels.

evidence.locator: Generate Gaussian Kernel; normalization; Divide by EVENT Marker; Separate Avoid and Escape
evidence.supports: Defines whole-session normalization, per-event smoothing, event labels and class-block row serialization; preprocessing is transductive with respect to later folds.
Freezes [-1000,+1000] ms, 50 ms bins, kernel-size 1000 and standard deviation 100; this is 40 bins per unit.
Original classifier archive contains per-session MATLAB X/y matrices; labels 3/4 encode avoidance/escape head withdrawals. Inventory lists the 15.09 MB EventClassificationData_4C.zip.

target.description: Figure 6B within-recording discrimination of avoidance head withdrawal versus escape head withdrawal from the same two-second peri-event population activity. This is retrospective peri-event decoding, not the separate early-prediction time-course in Figure 6C.

dataset.description: Dryad doi:10.5061/dryad.v9s4mw78c January 14 2026 release, EventClassificationData_4C.zip, preserving its processed per-session X/y representation. Complete archive identities and contents still require admission.

cohort.description: The published endpoint contains all 40 recording sessions. An authenticated archive-member roster and complete original rat/session identity mapping have not been read in this audit, so the exact 40-session inclusion remains an execution gate.

split.description: Author code specifies within-session StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=622), each original HW row held out once. Preserve seed 622, source row ordering and the original stratification protocol. Authenticate inputs and record package/version provenance when regenerating folds; a documented source-conformant rerun with paired candidate-author folds and predeclared justified calibration tolerance does not require an archived historical membership file. Animal/episode/time-based holdouts change the task.

inputs.description: All released X columns and all label-3/4 rows in every original session; training labels map 3=avoidance and 4=escape. Test labels remain protected during candidate execution. Each neuron contributes all 40 original bins.

preprocessing.description: Preserve source whole-session standardized, Gaussian-smoothed peri-event features and clipping to [-5,5]; BernoulliNB binarizes at zero. Whole-session normalization and symmetric smoothing remain disclosed; training-only preprocessing cannot undo this original transductive representation.

metric.description: Balanced accuracy per session = 0.5*(avoidance recall + escape recall), after pooling all five out-of-fold predictions and thresholding escape probability at >=0.5. Do not average fold accuracies or substitute probability reconstruction error.

aggregation.description: Arithmetic mean of complete session balanced accuracies across all 40 original sessions; the author batch routine computes the mean of its per-session HW accuracies. Session weighting and animal-level uncertainty are distinct.

comparison.primary_metric: Equal-session mean Figure 6B avoidance/escape balanced accuracy on original fivefold OOF predictions

published_baseline.description: Published real-label Figure 6B result is 72.71% = 0.7271. The 51.62% shuffled value is a separate historical control with unseeded randomness, not the primary performance target.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Source-authorized route is the pinned EventClassifier HW branch with all 40 sessions and source-specified fivefold stratification/seed 622. Regenerate folds from authenticated source rows with recorded environment provenance and shared candidate-author membership; calibrate the rerun to the published result under a predeclared justified tolerance. No numeric author rerun is established here; the local probability reference remains calibration. Strongest relevant original same-endpoint comparator qualification remains required; no weak replay or invented aggregate qualifies.

minimum_effect.rationale: A meaningful balanced-accuracy gain must be justified from original cohort variability and the behavioral interpretation before final testing. No arbitrary percentage-point margin is adopted.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired candidate-versus-author session differences and an uncertainty procedure that accounts for repeated sessions from the same rat; retain the original equal-session point estimate.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Rat for biological replication; sessions are nested observations.
uncertainty.rationale: The reported t(39) does not certify 40 independent animals. Without the complete rat/session ledger, neither a cluster-based interval nor a population claim is admitted.

paper_win_requires: Authenticate all 40 original sessions, source preprocessing and source-protocol folds regenerated with random_state=622 or recovered historical membership; no easier subset, changed time window or altered population.

Establish a source-conformant author BernoulliNB rerun, document seed 622 and environment/fold provenance, and reconcile it with published 0.7271 under a predeclared justified calibration tolerance before judging candidate performance.

Audit original SVC explorations and all relevant original same-endpoint comparators; BNB0.7271 is published but not authenticated as strongest. Exceed the strongest qualified original comparator and stronger published/replayed baseline under justified calibration.
Exceed the source result on the original balanced-accuracy endpoint with predeclared meaningful effect and valid paired uncertainty; a fit-to-reference score is not success.
Freeze the candidate before final scoring on the same source-protocol folds as the author baseline, protect labels and prevent class-block row order or original indices from leaking the target.

Treat nested logistic controls as separate competence checks. A documented rerun of the source protocol retains the same task; whole-animal, episode, time-based or otherwise changed split schemes are extensions.

Superiority applies only to original real-label decoding. Full source-shuffle outputs remain mandatory controls/fidelity evidence; higher shuffled performance is not an improvement. A paper-relative win is not current SOTA.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison was verified; source-paper results and any future author rerun remain separate comparators.

episode.improvement_loop: After original input/reference/replay admission, iterate only on declared training and internal validation within original training partitions. Retain complete source support; no numerical final-test or cross-condition feedback.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze independent candidate code per outcome/condition, original support/split/input joins, hyperparameter policy, complete output interface, calibrated references, uncertainty/effect criteria and finite budgets before final test exposure.
episode.final_evaluation: Evaluate frozen candidate and qualified strongest original author on identical original input/fold support. All 40 source sessions, all label-3/4 HW rows, all units × 40 peri-event bins, all five OOF folds, both class recalls, per-session balanced accuracy, complete probabilities and source-shuffle companions. Historical unseeded shuffle 0.5162 and newly seeded engineering controls remain separately labelled. Superiority concerns real-label endpoint only; shuffle outputs are compulsory controls.
episode.baseline_policy: Preserve published source scores/vectors, source-faithful author replay and candidate outputs separately. Qualify strongest relevant original comparator; reconcile published/replay differences under justified tolerance. Controls/engineering references are separately named, never a weaker surrogate. No current SOTA claim.

blocking_issues: Authenticate EventClassificationData_4C.zip (15,089,711 bytes), all original 40 session members and rat/session mapping; archive body is not admitted.
Regenerate source StratifiedKFold(5,shuffle=True,random_state=622) from authenticated source rows and record package environment; lack of archived historical memberships alone is not disqualifying.

Qualify complete source-author BNB replay and published0.7271 calibration. Audit original SVC explorations and all relevant same-endpoint comparators before deciding which original result is strongest.

Freeze justified effect/paired uncertainty with equal-session metric and rat dependence; retain complete original shuffle companions and distinguish unseeded historical from seeded engineering controls.

Authentic input/source custody, independent qualified references and replay, protected paired participant execution, frozen candidate interface, exact exposure manifests and finite access/compute budgets remain unresolved. No scientific/model execution is claimed.
